descriptor: Fast city rides with upfront fares

voice.summary: Kerbhop sounds like a cab driver who knows the streets and quotes a fair price before you get in. Copy is brisk and British, with minutes and pounds always stated up front.
dos: Show the fare and the wait together, like '3 min away, £9.30'
Use plain street words: pickup, drop-off, kerb
Confirm every step with a short present-tense line
donts: Do not hide surge or fees behind small print
Avoid slang that confuses first-time riders
Never promise an arrival time the map cannot back up

taglines: Know the fare before you go
Three minutes away, give or take
Hop in, we know the way
boilerplate: Kerbhop is a ride-hailing app that shows live fares, seat counts and arrival times for every vehicle before a driver is requested.

microcopy.success: Driver found. Priya is two minutes away.
microcopy.error: We could not find a driver. Try a different vehicle.
microcopy.empty: No saved places yet. Add home or work.

logo.note: A target pin marks the pickup point, the one moment the whole service is built around.
